title: "Landscape"

Standing sector map of low-altitude economy businesses: who is doing what in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area and among a few global benchmarks. Industry holds dated news of the same firms; News holds government and regulatory items; Tracker holds official status.

Sources (as of 7 Oct 2026): entries are added only from LAE-Intel's landscape packet and are checked against the cited page. Empty sectors are waiting for that packet. Company claims are not treated as fact.

## How to read the tags

Each firm or project carries one source-type tag:

- **Company-announced:** the description comes from the company itself. It is the company's claim, not an established fact.
- **Independently reported:** a news outlet described it from its own sources or checks, beyond the company's statement.
- **Officially confirmed:** a government body or regulator has confirmed the activity in an official release or document, which is linked.

Order values, fleet sizes, delivery counts and launch dates are shown as claimed, with who claimed them. Do not cite this page for official figures; use Tracker.

## How entries appear

Each entry under a sector: firm or project · place, a one-line activity note, then Tag / Status / Source, with a collapsed Chinese or official bilingual box where the source needs one.
